title: Local comparison at a single good index (Simon 7.2.4 (9)–(11); steps 7–8 of the parent)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, A, W, F ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in A (IsMinimizingIn T A) with spt T ⊆ A, R an integer multiplicity representation of T in U (IMRep, R.Represents T), C, S, Ŷ, Sr ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), π : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, G, G₃, L ∈ ℝ and e ∈ [0, ∞]. Assume: 0 < G, 2G ≤ G₃, closedBall(0, G₃) ⊆ U, M_{B_{G₃}(0)}(T) < ∞ and 1 ≤ L; either A ∩ B_{2G}(0) = ∅, or π is C¹ on B_{2G}(0), maps B_{2G}(0) into A ∩ B_{G₃}(0), satisfies π(y) = y for every y ∈ A ∩ B_{2G}(0) and ‖Dπ(y)‖ ≤ L for every y ∈ B_{2G}(0); W is open, F is compact, W ⊆ F ⊆ B_G(0) and μ_R(F ∖ W) = 0 (μ_R = R.measure); C and S are integer multiplicity, ∂S = ∂C and spt(S − C) ⊆ W; Ŷ is integer multiplicity, ∂Ŷ = 0, spt Ŷ ⊆ F and μ_{R′}(F ∖ W) ≤ e for every integer multiplicity representation R′ of Ŷ in ℝ^P; M(Sr) ≤ e; and C(ω) = currentEval(T, ω) + Ŷ(ω) + Sr(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Assume the push-forward theorem (PF) for (P, m): for every open O ⊆ ℝ^P, every f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P that is C¹ on O and every c ∈ ℝ with ‖Df(y)‖ ≤ c for y ∈ O, there is a map push : 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) → 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that (A) for every X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with spt X compact and contained in O and every IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of X in ℝ^P: (i) push X(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(f(x)) ∘ Λⁿ Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), (ii) push X is integer multiplicity, (iii) spt(push X) ⊆ f(spt X), (iv) M(push X) ≤ cⁿ·M(X) (ENNReal.ofReal(cⁿ)), (v) ∂X = 0 implies ∂(push X) = 0, (vi) if f(y) = y for every y ∈ spt X then push X = X; and (B) push(X₁ − X₂) = push X₁ − push X₂ for all integer multiplicity X₁, X₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with compact supports contained in O. Then M_W(T) ≤ Lⁿ·(M_W(S) + 2e) + (Lⁿ − 1)·M_{B_{G₃}(0)}(T) in [0, ∞] (with Lⁿ and Lⁿ − 1 read as ENNReal.ofReal(Lⁿ), ENNReal.ofReal(Lⁿ − 1)).
